narrative.intro: Applied Research Solutions has $242M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Applied Research Solutions won 7 awards so far, with an average award size of $34.5M. Obligations fell 9.4% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $235M, and the General Services Administration follows with $6.4M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the largest market, accounting for $223M in obligations. Secondary markets include Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $11.9M, Engineering Services at $6.4M, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at $921K. Historical obligations show multi-year activity: FY21 $207M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $238M, FY24 $208M, FY25 $267M, and FY26 $242M. This record shows Applied Research Solutions concentrating work with a single major agency and focused activity in R&D markets during the fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Applied Research Solutions' federal revenues?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $235M, so Applied Research Solutions' federal revenues are highly concentrated with one agency. The General Services Administration is the only other listed buyer at $6.4M, which leaves most obligations tied to Defense. The largest NAICS market is Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at $223M, indicating sector concentration as well.
